run_info_command: run the InfoCommand to display details about a specific benchpress job by name
populate_parser_info: populate the CLI subparser with the info command arguments including job name and json flag
print_job_as_table: print benchpress job details as a formatted table showing roles, arguments, and hooks
print_job_as_json: print benchpress job configuration as JSON output using the json flag
review_InfoCommand_class: review the InfoCommand class that extends BenchpressCommand to provide job detail output
